unverified_statements.text: When and how often the Layercake load schedule runs in production.
unverified_statements.reason: No artefact gives the production schedule; the runbook says it is still to be confirmed.

unverified_statements.text: The production server and database the migrations MIG-0003, MIG-0004 and MIG-0005 are deployed to, and who carries out the production deployment.
unverified_statements.reason: ENVIRONMENTS.md records production only as client-specific and that a person deploys there; no artefact names the server, database or deployer.

unverified_statements.text: The name of the reporting role that should receive read access on Layercake.fact_contact_payment and Layercake.vw_contact_payment_reconciliation.
unverified_statements.reason: Not recorded in any artefact (CN-MOD-002 and CN-MOD-003 deviations); the grants cannot be run until it is confirmed.

unverified_statements.text: Data volumes for FO payment transactions and the load window for the payment load (Q-025).
unverified_statements.reason: Q-025 is open in the design; ADR-001's full rebuild is provisional until it is answered.

unverified_statements.text: The order in which migrations MIG-0003 to MIG-0005 must be applied.
unverified_statements.reason: Number order is implied by the rule that down scripts run only in reverse order, but no artefact states the apply order, so the pack gives only the rollback order.
